description: Codefuse hooks.json configured UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse/Stop but omitted SessionStart. Drift session never initialized, scoring pipeline broken from day one.

label.annotator_notes: Third instance of incomplete_followthrough pattern (after case_063 task closure, case_064 codex hooks). ~/.codefuse/hooks.json had 3 of 4 required hooks but missed SessionStart — the one that initializes the drift session and resets state. Without it, UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse hooks fire into a session that was never started, so goal is never set and scoring has no baseline. Agent that configured this understood the hook system well enough to write a correct drift-hook.sh wrapper and register 3 event types, but missed the foundational one. Discovered when user asked why Aone Copilot sessions had no drift visibility.

failure_fixture.root_failure: SessionStart hook not registered in ~/.codefuse/hooks.json; drift session never initialized
secondary_failures: 3/4 hooks present created false confidence that setup was complete
trace_refs: No .drift-state.json or .drift-events.jsonl produced for codefuse sessions

root.evidence: Agent configured 3/4 hooks correctly (UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, Stop) but omitted SessionStart — the hook that initializes the drift session. The wrapper script drift-hook.sh was correct and would handle SessionStart if called, but the hooks.json registration was incomplete.

secondary.evidence: Without SessionStart, the drift session is never initialized. Subsequent hooks (UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse) fire but have no session context to score against. No error is raised — the failure is completely silent.

diagnosis.why_eval_missed: The hook wrapper script (drift-hook.sh) correctly handles all 4 event types including SessionStart. The hooks.json registered 3 of 4. No runtime error occurs — the missing hook simply never fires. A health check testing 'do hooks execute?' would pass for the 3 registered hooks.
diagnosis.replay_oracle: When configuring drift hooks for any agent runtime, does the agent verify that ALL 4 required hooks (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, Stop) are registered, not just a subset?
ambiguities: This is the third instance of the same failure pattern across three different runtimes (case_064 codex, case_064 claude, case_065 codefuse). Whether to count as one recurring pattern or three separate cases depends on analysis granularity.

goals.raw: SessionStart hook 注入这个Claude或者antcc为什么看不到

observable_targets: investigate and fix missing SessionStart hook in codefuse

payload.message: cat ~/.codefuse/hooks.json — found UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse/Stop but no SessionStart
